dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, it's finally done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, all that "ley flow" and "elemental lines" stuff Lisa was going on about should hopefully be back to normal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wanna go back and see how the <color=#00E1FFFF>Knights</color> are doing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if you got anything more interesting to do, Paimon can come too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like... going on a shopping spree... or checking out the <color=#00E1FFFF>Statue of The Seven</color> again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At the temples of The Four Winds, we found something like... solidified wind, didn't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In Mondstadt, people call them "Anemoculi."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're called this because they can be fitted into the statue's eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Some fairy tales say the statues' eyes originally had gems that were taken by swallows.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Anemoculi never had a physical form from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: People with Visions collect them to offer to the <color=#00E1FFFF>statues</color> in exchange for blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unlike others with powers, you don't have a Vision. But then the rules of this world don't apply to you anyway so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can go see what happens right now, if you wanna try!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The statue in Windrise should be the closest one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't wait to see what the gods do to you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about we explore the area ahead of us later?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Two stars clashed with the heart of a shattered world

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of the twins that fell to this world, one is awaking from slumber

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You opened your eyes in the bitter cold with the hope for a better world

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Only to be greeted by the sight of your {M#sister}{F#brother} being impaled by chains

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A foreign goddess descends from the skies and takes away your only kin

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yet failing to avenge your twin, you succumbed to a dark slumber...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you come to, the world around you is not as you remember

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Time that remained stagnant for an eternity began flowing anew

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You embarked on a perilous journey alone

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In search of the goddess who took everything from you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Two months later

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... what you're trying to say is that you fell here... from another world?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But when you wanted to leave, and go on to the next world...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your path was blocked by some unknown god?

dialogues.speaker: God
dialogues.text: Outlanders, your journey ends here

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who're you!?

dialogues.speaker: God
dialogues.text: The sustainer of heavenly principles. The arrogation of mankind ends now

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lumine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aether!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Give my {M#sister}{F#brother} back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #And just like that, the god took away my {M#sister}{F#brother}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some kind of seal was cast upon me, and I lost my power.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{M#So while we used to travel from world to world, we are now trapped here.}{F#So whilst we used to cross world after world, we are now trapped here.}

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How many years ago was it? I don't know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But I intend to find out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{M#When I woke, I was all alone — until I met you two months ago...}{F#After I awoke, I was all alone — right up until I met you two months ago.}

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, Paimon really owes you for that. Otherwise Paimon likely would have drowned...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Paimon will do her best to be a great guide!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should head off. Let's get going!
